content:
Ivy: follow-up on aliasing vs materialize debate. Want a small safety-first design we can ship quickly.
Marco: yep. propose three-layer model: 1) pass-through exact match, 2) alias mapping (name->runtime_profile) with conservative checks, 3) convert-on-deploy for customers that want artifact parity.
Neel: conservative checks = require quant_fingerprint present + similarity metric > 0.9. If missing, mapping rejected unless owner ack.
Ivy: agree. also need clear telemetry: runtime should emit header X-precision-resolve: orig=<orig>;resolved=<resolved>;fallback=<code>. Logs include kernel_id and fp_hash.
Marco: sample config for ops teams:
```
precision_policy:
  default: pass-through
  tenants:
    beta-corp: alias
  mappings:
    "vendor/modelX/fp8-small": "redwood/int8/modelX-safe-v1"
  safety:
    similarity_threshold: "0.9"
    shadow_sample_size: "50"
    live_ramp_steps: "[1,5,20,100]"
```
Neel: runbook snippet: monitor deg_score and fallback_rate. If deg_delta > 0.02 or fallback_rate > 1% for 5m -> disable mapping, notify owner, start shadow replay.
Ivy: onboarding lint: block ambiguous names and require fp_hash. Console should show "effective precision" and a link to last shadow-compare.
Marco: action items: Marco -> mapping schema proto, Neel -> header + runtime logging, Ivy -> runbook + console flag. ops-bot: ticket QUANT-ALIAS-311 created and assigned to eng-ml.
Neel: I'll post a short PR for the header enums today.
Ivy: nice, keep mapping opt-in per model until we have stable telemetry. :thumbsup:
